bandReport.notes: Band covers p14 (Q91-96), p15 (Q97-104), p16 (Q105-112), p17 (Q113-120). Q91 opens cleanly at the head of p14's left column, so nothing continues from p13. THE PAPER ENDS AT Q120: p17 is the last physical page of an 18-page PDF; Q120's option (d) is the last printed line of the right column, below it are the column rules' ends, the footer 'GHSA-B-GNL  ( 35 - A )', and then roughly a quarter-page of blank paper with NO '[ P.T.O.' and no further question number. The run 91->120 is contiguous with no gaps and no duplicates. Nothing on my pages belongs to a neighbouring band; Q90 and earlier are entirely on p13 and before. TWO-COLUMN INTEGRITY: all four pages carry exactly 4 questions per column except p14 (3 per column), and every column ends on a COMPLETE option block — Q93(d), Q96(d), Q100(d), Q104(d), Q108(d), Q112(d), Q116(d) and Q120(d) are each the last printed line of their column — so no stem or option block splits across a column break anywhere in this band, and every option set was read from the same column as its own stem. CODE-OPTION ORDER: five code blocks in this band and three of them are NON-standard, so the order was read off the page individually for each - Q95 is (a) 1 only / (b) 2 and 3 only / (c) 1, 2 and 3 only / (d) 1, 2, 3 and 4; Q102 is (a) 1 only / (b) 2 and 3 only / (c) 1 and 3 only / (d) 1, 2 and 3; Q118 is (a) 1 only / (b) 1 and 3 only / (c) 2 and 3 only / (d) 1, 2 and 3. Q108, Q111 and Q115 use the standard 1 only / 2 only / Both / Neither. No all-options row sits at (a) or (b) anywhere in this band, and there is no self-referential option. No figures, diagrams or graphs on any of the four pages. No Match List (List-I/List-II) in this band; Q98 and Q102 are pair questions and use the corpus ':' pair convention rather than a table.
